iconPromptBase: Use case: stylized-concept. Production square terminal-tab raster artwork, a miniature premium PC-game item illustration, NOT a UI mockup. Painterly material richness, deep layered atmospheric dark background, restrained jewel colors, key light from upper left, cool subtle rim, beautiful shadows and tangible materials. Central established symbol occupies 75-80% of square, dominant clean silhouette almost front-facing, thick readable forms and broad highlights that survive 20px downsampling. Background subdued and low contrast. Full-bleed square, no rounded app tile, no border, no frame, no text label, no caption, no UI, no watermark. Detailed and beautiful at 1024 square yet instantly recognizable at 20px.

entries.backgroundPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one panoramic 3:1 painted background asset for a developer terminal tab, premium PC-game inventory illustration style. No UI, text, letters, symbols, logos, frames or borders. Rich believable minerals and metal, restrained jewel colors, directional top-left light and subtle rim reflections, deep atmospheric layers. Most of the middle and left TWO THIRDS must be very dark, calm negative space for live program label; interesting environmental storytelling concentrated at far right and edges. The center horizontal strip must work when cropped to an extremely wide shallow tab, so large broad readable environmental shapes, not tiny detail. Dark graphite shadows dominate, carefully selective color, no excessive bloom. Beautiful sophisticated digital painting, full-bleed scene, landscape aspect ratio 3:1. A warm copper forge, dark charcoal and reddish slate slabs, far-right an amber fire illuminating hammered copper plates, very few subtle sparks and smoke. Left and center almost black warm graphite.
